title: Window Command Availability Snapshot v2
problem: Window runtime command/action availability publication must be bounded, observable, and frame-scoped. Pointer movement over overlay-heavy UI must not synchronously recompute full widget availability, overlay pointer-move dispatch must stay under the initial 1.5ms gate, and command availability frames above 500us must expose per-command/per-route attribution.

repro.summary: Run the UI Gallery overlay pointer-move steady perf script with suite prewarm/prelude normalization, then inspect the worst bundle with diag stats.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag perf --repeat 7 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --prelude-each-run --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --dir target/fret-diag/codex-command-availability-pointer-after-focus-cache-20260516 --max-pointer-move-dispatch-us 1500 --max-pointer-move-hit-test-us 500 tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/perf/ui-gallery-overlay-pointer-move-steady.json --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full
